status_definitions.matched: The bounded factual result is supported by new observations or fresh artifacts, not necessarily historical raw-byte identity.
status_definitions.deviation: A fresh counterexample contradicts the stated general claim.
status_definitions.not_testable: Historical event, missing raw evidence or full-text material was not recoverable/reviewed here.
status_definitions.source_supported: Supported by inspected code or scope records, not certified by a new end-to-end execution.
status_definitions.pending: Required new run or final comparison remains in progress.
